One of the first thing's that was done, was that we upgraded the engine version from the Portal 2 version of Source, to the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive version of Source. Doing this was a no-brainer, as it meant we wouldn't need to write code for things we wanted, like porting to other platforms, better optimized maps and lighting, etc.

[b][u]More Platforms[/u][/b]
Our goal for Blade Symphony Free to Play is to have more players, not make money. We've received quite a bit of feedback from people who would like to play Blade Symphony on their Mac or Linux computers, so we put in the time and effort to ensure it runs native on those platforms!

[url=https://imgur.com/ULDPhJE][img]http://i.imgur.com/ULDPhJE.gif[/img][/url]
Blade Symphony on Mac

[url=https://imgur.com/PfPbwMy][img]http://i.imgur.com/PfPbwMy.gif[/img][/url]
Blade Symphony on Linux

[b][u]More Languages[/u][/b]
We're positive there have been people who refunded Blade Symphony because it didn't support their language. Who wants to learn through a tutorial, when you can't read one of the three languages Blade Symphony supports. So in addition to English, Russian and Japanese, we're going to translate Blade Symphony into as many European, Western Asian and Eastern Asian languages as possible. We're crowd sourcing this effort, so if you'd like to help, stay tuned.

[b][u]Better Performance[/u][/b]
The engine upgrade allowed us to get some better frame rates on our maps (omitting duel_box.) This should also affect overall performance of the game, in menus and popups.

[b][u]Level over Rank Progression[/u][/b]
This was a contentious point for us. The system of giving people a global rank based on ELO, placing them into a ladder on global rank, and prescribing a league based on their ladder position will have to go away. This system is powered through this pretty expansive website that communicates with the game. While we love this website and how it can do that for the game, it's a pretty big dependency that is showing it's age. I detail more about that here. Replacing it, is something that 90% of can be managed by Steam, a level system.

It's simple; as you play a character, you gain experience points (XP.) You get a big XP bonus based on whether you won the duel or if you won any round at all. You also get XP modifiers based on a grade we give you in areas such as [b]Stance Diversity[/b], [b]Tier Usage[/b], [b]Mobility[/b], and [b]Hit Redirection[/b]. This is to encourage use of the breadth that Blade Symphony's tactical sword fighting gameplay offers. Finally, we'll be handing out some bonuses based on whether it's your first time playing of the day, the week or whether a special event is running.

[url=http://d1lwzw8l6ovcth.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/endroundscreen.png][img]http://d1lwzw8l6ovcth.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/endroundscreen.png[/img][/url]
A concept for an end-round screen.

[b][u]Progression Rewards[/u][/b]
It wouldn't be much fun to progress in Blade Symphony if you weren't given rewards for doing so. As such, we're going to reward players based on their level by unlocking things like [b]swords[/b], [b]masks[/b], [b]armor attachments[/b], [b]capes[/b], [b]sword glow types[/b], [b]intro backgrounds[/b], [b]foot step colors[/b], [b]sword glow colors[/b],[b] [/b][b]armor colors[/b], [b]scoreboard name color[/b] and [b]in-game chat colors[/b]. Sword glow color, armor color, scoreboard name color and in-game chat colors will be specific color items that you unlock such as Phalanx's sword glow color [b]Greater Wing Royal Red[/b], Pure's armor color [b]Hokuten Assassin Recruit Green[/b], or Judgement's armor color [b]Murai Knight Executor Blue[/b].

[url=http://d1lwzw8l6ovcth.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/cxGJ5HU.gif][img]http://d1lwzw8l6ovcth.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/cxGJ5HU.gif[/img][/url]
An example of the 'Pulsing' Sword Glow.

[b][u]Marketplace Content[/u][/b]
In addition to rewards based on your level, we're also going to sell some content on the new Blade Symphony marketplace. Everyone who owns the game will get all of the in-game developer-made swords, masks, attachments and skins, and any capes unlocked with notes. This does not include capes given to those who won them under special circumstances; that's exclusive to them. In addition, we'll be adding intro backgrounds (named above, also unlockable,) and potentially intro emblems.

[h1][b][u]What's Not Changing[/u][/b][/h1]
Understand that the list of the following is not set in stone. Instead of having a third 'maybe changing' category, I'm putting everything into two bucks of "definitely changing" and "maybe or not changing." This is the latter bucket.

[b][u]New or Changed Moves[/u][/b]
Sadly, new moves (attacks, blocks, emotes, bows, rolls, shuffles) mean new animations. We don't currently have a developer that can animate and implement these. In addition, we would need an animator to properly balance the gameplay related moves (attacks, blocks, rolls and shuffles,) for each character. That's a lot of time, a lot of expense, and nobody to do it.

[b][u]New or Changed Characters[/u][/b]
Some of the characters have some obvious graphical issues, and our sixth character was never completed. Because new characters in Blade Symphony aren't as easy as making a new model, and adding it to a list, a sixth character would only happen if Free-To-Play does well or we get some kind of Kickstarter for it. Changes to characters are equally time consuming and expensive, because any time we change the mesh of a character, the UV map, texture, mask and attachment points and animations all either have to be modified or re-exported. That's a chain of three different people right there.

[b][u]New Maps[/u][/b]
We don't have any level designers that are free to work on Blade Symphony. Even if we did, creating a new map also takes a few months. It's unlikely we would do a new level at all, and it's more likely we will touch up the ones we have for performance (stated above.) I've given thought into having a mapping contest, in the past, but when we did these for Dystopia we ended up having to significantly touch up the winning maps to meet the quality bar of the developer made maps.

[h1][b][u]When's It Releasing[/u][/b][/h1]
Hopefully, with Blade Symphony's price being $0, it being available on two more platforms and in many more languages, our hope is that this will drive more players. As I said earlier, the goal isn't to make money, but it helps things go faster.

There is no easily predictable timeline for Blade Symphony Free-To-Play, but we're going as fast as we can with a single developer working on this. We're going to shift one of our previous artists to help us with some much needed art related tasks on a part-time basis, and I hope that means that we can meet our current target. Our current target is [b]End of January 2018[/b].

[h1][b][u]Playing Free-To-Play Early[/u][/b][/h1]
We need to be able to support the one, soon to be two, developers that work on Blade Symphony. In exchange for certain rewards like in-game icons, your name in the credits, a weekly live-stream from the developers and access to what we're working on, [url=https://www.patreon.com/punyhuman]you can support our Patreon here[/url]. Doing so will get you a key to the Blade Symphony Beta. As more people play the Beta, the more we can find and solve critical bugs, and release on time.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/bePatron?u=967507][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4458819/f372ffddd9c291322709f8b620ac4ae155e18439.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b][u]How You Can Help[/u][/b][/h1]
We could really use some talented level designers or artists to help us make some new items, touch up our levels, animations or characters. I already know the perfect candidates for most people, because they're the people who did it for us in the past. However, I can't pay them in wishes and dreams. If you've already bought the game, and want to help out, consider telling a friend that we're going Free-To-Play so that they may purchase it.

Lastly, if you can't support us financially, consider [url=https://discord.gg/0mwqiAXNdc08V7jU]joining our Discord[/url] and be a part of the community. There are weekly active pick-up games, some upcoming tournaments and a pretty chatty bunch of players.

[url=https://discord.gg/0mwqiAXNdc08V7jU][img]http://i.imgur.com/4ZbBzh2.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch 4026 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Summary[/h1]
2016 was a very quiet year for Blade Symphony development, so we hoped to end it with an update. What will hopefully be one of numerous updates, entering into the New Year and beyond, we have brought achievements!

Our plans are to add more achievements, to honor those on Kickstarter that backed us at that level. However, what better way to get the ball rolling then to add a handful to begin with! In addition, we hope that we’ve tackled some good quality of life fixes that address some glaring issues.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cN8jh8S.png[/img]

EDIT: We've pushed a few fixes affecting how Bad Sportsmanship, Two For One, and Touchy Feely are earned.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 25 new achievements.
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/225600/achievements]See the complete list and descriptions.[/url]
[/list]
[h1]Capes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Summer 2016 North American Tournament cape (Created by Jester)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed infamous “air stance” bug. Please let us know if you see this again.
[*]Fixed bug allowing a listenserver host to be kicked
[*]Fixed bug allowing player to feint twice.
[*]Fixed bug causing players to not block shurikens when facing attacker.
[*]Graphical fixes to loading bar on the loading screen
[*]Graphical fixes to buttons on the main menu
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added convar sv_one_hit_kill to allow deaths in one blow.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3994 - The AI Opponent Improvement Patch, Item Price Reduction + Capes!
notes.content:
[h1]- Bots -[/h1]

This patch features significant improvements to the training bot's behavior.
I was very passionate about bot improvement during the early development stages of the game, but it was never something that featured high on our priority list. Recently I've been working on the bot on and off and slowly making some progress. I guess my main goal is to have a bot that is less predictable and more responsive, these two attributes are probably what were missing most. I've still got a long way to go before I achieve some of my own personal goals; however, I do feel the bot has now come a long way already.

I could list all the things I've improved with the bot but I think it would be more pleasing if you guys fired up the [b]Training - AI Opponent[/b] and see for your selves. Simply choose an opponent, select the sword (Longsword, Scimitar, Rapier play the best Jian is also quite good and Katana probably takes the least effective award). You should leave the rest of the settings in the AI Opponent menu set to default or random. If you feel the bot is still to easy by all means step up and play [b]2 vs 1[/b]!

Here's an earlier video I showed before to some of you (the terri-bad quality one).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dps1LSFVQGU

[h1]- Reduction of Notes for all Official items -[/h1]

I've decided to cut the price (Notes) of all the official items by [b]-50%[/b] 
(for those that don't know they're not micro-transactions, you just have to win on duel ranked servers to gain them).

[h1]- Capes -[/h1]

I've added four new purchasable capes to the game:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dz2V8m8.png[/img]

I decided to make two traditional looking capes and two high tech capes, I hope you'll enjoy them!

[i]Lastly...[/i]

[h1]-Tournament Capes -[/h1]

30 players from the last tournament should all now receive their [b]unique[/b] capes. Thanks to Hikki.exe and ManOfHonor for designing and organising them.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ndXEPUw.png[/img]

Here's a list of the players who won a cape in the tournament:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ryokuclanrecruits/discussions/0/357286119117165732/


Sorry, no balancing this patch :riot:, maybe the next one. Also I started to work on adding faction specific character selection music and meditation music, but I haven't finish that yet :vlc:.

notes.title: Happy Birthday Blade Symphony.
notes.content:
2 years since Steam Official release,
3 years since Steam Early Access,
5 years since Kickstarter and first public Alpha.
And around 8 years since original inception.

I first saw this game myself back in 2010 on moddb. I knew then that this would be something I'd like to play. I participated in the public alpha at the beginning of 2011, I backed the game and team on Kickstarter the summer of 2011 after being completely hooked on the alpha. In August that year I joined the team, for me the rest is history. 

[h1]People have come and gone, players and developers a like, our fallen Heroes will be missed for everyone of them fought gallantly. The battle is not over, it probably never will be, everyday new challengers arrive striving to wield their swords with the same steady grip as their masters, and masters before them.[/h1]

PunyHuman would like to thank everyone who has given the game a fair shot, we bow before those who have dueled for countless hours trying to develop and perfect their own unique style. 
A [b]big[/b] thank you to the community contributors!
There are too many to mention all by name. People have contributed to this game in so, so many ways, the teachers, the tournament organizers, the casters, commentators, streamers, guide writers, server operators, scripters, mappers and of course the workshoppers! As others have said before its these contributions that have made the game!

notes.title: Steam Workshop now has Sketchfab previews!
notes.content:
You can now add Sketchfab 3D previews of your workshop model to your workshop item's page.


Here's an example:

Sketchfab:

https://sketchfab.com/models/7356fd0bc0a5464fa36f8319da0d1a09

Workshop page:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=451299843

Here's the official Steam Announcement:

http://steamcommunity.com/games/SteamWorkshop/announcements/detail/950630846486279664

I'll quickly run you through the steps to get it working for Blade Symphony:
[list]
[*]Get a Sketchfab account at https://sketchfab.com/
[*]Click upload and browse to your blade symphony workshop_temp folder and search for your workshop item's .VPK file (you can use the id in your workshop page url to find it in windows explorer search steam_urlID).
[*]Once uploaded tweak your 3D settings and grab the page URL of your model from your browser (not the link given when uploaded).
[*]Go to your workshop item's page and click edit/add images on the right you can add your sketchfab url, save and you should be done.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Showdown Tournament Info!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m8LBxul.png[/img]

[h1]All information can be found at the official group page[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016]Here![/url]

[b]If you wish to participate please leave a message in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447331652152474/]the Sign-Up Thread[/url].[/b]


[h1][b]What is Team Deathmatch Showdown?[/b][/h1]
[i]Team Deathmatch Showdown[/i] is a variation of Battlechess. 2 teams with 5 players each fight each other. Both teams decide on which player to send out to fight. Then those selected players will [i]fight each other in a 1v1 duel[/i]. We'll use Duel Box as our map, no FFA and only 1v1 duels, one player per team at a time. Each player only fights once per team matchup. A team wins if it scores 3 wins. For more detailed information [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447331652166308/][b]have a look at the Rules-Thread[/b][/url]. [i]Subject to change![/i]

[h1][b]Tournament Date[/b][/h1]
[i]tbd, sometime in April[/i]

[h1][b]Links[/b][/h1]
[b]Challonge Tournament Brackets[/b] [i]tbd[/i]
[b][url=http://www.twitch.tv/zypresaurus]Stream[/url][/b]

[h1][b]Prizes[/b][/h1]
A cape for the first place's team. Everyone in team will get a cape and get a game from the [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447613576606094/]prize pool[/url].[/b]


[u][b]How do I check in?[/b][/u]
Join the group chat 2 hours before the tournament begins. Just one member has to check in, and if need be, inform of any team changes / subs. Any team who did not check in 10 minutes before the actual tournament started is [u]disqualified[/u] and [u]removed from the brackets[/u].

[u][b]I can't find a team / I'm missing a member for my team?![/b][/u]
No problem, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447331652236572/][b]have a look at this thread[/b][/url].

[u][b]I don't live in Europe. Can I still participate?[/b][/u]
[i]Of course,[/i] everyone can enter this tournament, as long as they find a team. There might be different servers for US and AUS, but that has yet to be decided.

[u][b]Can I donate for prizes?[/b][/u]
If you would like to donate something as a prize for the 1st, 2nd, 3rd place winners of the tournament please leave a message in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447331652149590/][b]Help and Donation-Thread[/b][/url] along with what you'll be donating. And much obliged! ♥

[u][b]Can I help with organizing, commentating, streaming, etc?[/b][/u]
Of course! We still need people to get this to work, if you feel like helping don't hesitate and post in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447331652149590/][b]Help and Donation-Thread[/b][/url] along with what you wanna do. Thanks for your help! ☻



[b]Still questions regarding the rules? [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSST2016/discussions/0/412447331652166308/][b]Click here![/b][/url][/b]


[b]Organizing:[/b] Ichmag, Circlejerk
[b]Front-page editing:[/b] Niky
[b]Hosting:[/b] fug4life, eBunny
[b]Streaming:[/b] Zypre
[b]Commentating:[/b] [i]tbd[/i]

notes.title: Team Deathmatch World Tournament
notes.content:
As previously [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/bladesymphony/announcements/detail/986652238086598642]announced[/url] a new community run tournament is happening in just over a month, on the 20th February.

The format for the tournament will be Team Deathmatch. Full details for the tournament are as follows:

[h1]How to play[/h1]

Teams will be made up of 5 players each. 
Each team starts with 10 points. Teams lose 1 point for every player that is killed. 
There will be no respawns until the final fight, once you're dead, you're out.

The finals will be a 5v5v5, with the possibility for even more depending on the amount of participants.

The tournament will be following a custom bracket.
The seeds are to be randomly generated by using the following website -  https://www.random.org/.

The tournament will take place in a circle shaped arena. The starting positions for each of the players will look like the following:

The arena for 5v5 - http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=599865466
The arena for the finals - http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=599866220.
Each of the Team's Captains will choose their players' starting positions independently from the other teams. You will not be able to change your position once your opponent's position has been revealed.

[h1]Event Rules[/h1]

In addition to the rules of the event, the following ones also apply.

Don't disrupt the event - this includes anything that hinders the progress of the event and generally uncooperative behaviour. 
Respect everyone - this is a community driven event, so be nice, be friendly, but more importantly have fun! 

The rules for the tournament will be strictly enforced, so please be aware of all of the rules before participating.

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

A cape is rewarded to each player that is a member of the top 3 teams.

There will be 3 teams per region, with the potential of 60 capes in total being given away!
Different ranks will receive different capes.

There will also be a prize pool containing prizes given to the tournament by donators. If you would like to contribute to this prize pool then please post in this thread - http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSTDMWT/discussions/0/458604254452248499/

[h1]Tournament Date[/h1]

The tournament will take place on the 20th of February.
A rehearsal will be taking place on the 13th of February, where all attendees will have an opportunity to practice prior to the start of the tournament on the 20th.

[h1]Want to help?[/h1]

The tournament organisers are still looking for suggestions and for any additional helpers.
Please post in this thread if you are looking to help or have a suggestion-  
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSTDMWT/discussions/0/496880503082303542/

[h1]How to join[/h1]

If you wish to participate in the tournament, join the tournament's group and take part in appropriate discussion thread in there - http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BSTDMWT

notes.title: Community Event: AUS vs US TDM
notes.content:
Blade Symphony's first international Team Deathmatch event is due to take place soon.

The goal of this event is to get old veterans reinvested in the game, and to also give newer players a chance to get involved with the community. 

[h1]Server[/h1]

Unfortunately there aren't any active Australian servers at the moment. So the event will be held on the North American server: "For The Community, By The Community." Unless the Australian server situation changes.

[h1]How to Play[/h1]

Two teams of ten players - one team consisting of US players and the other of AUS players - will fight it out in an arena. Players can respawn after death, but each team has a finite amount of tickets that will decrease as players of those teams die. The round ends when one team loses all of their tickets, and the team that still has tickets wins. The winning condition is going to be "first to three wins" (in other words, best three out of five rounds). 

[h1]Event Rules[/h1]

Don't disrupt the event - this includes anything that hinders the progress of the event and generally uncooperative behaviour. 
Respect everyone - this is a community-driven event, so be nice, be friendly, but more importantly have fun! 

[h1]Date[/h1]

The date of the event is 19 December for USA, and 20 December for AUS. 
USA: 8 PM EST, 7 PM CST 
AUS: 12 PM AEDT, 11 PM AEST 

Note: Dates/times of the events can change with short notice. Check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/AUSvsUS2k15]AUS vs US 2k15 group[/url] for updates.

If you have any questions, please ask any of the moderators or officers of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/AUSvsUS2k15]AUS vs US 2k15 group[/url].

notes.title: Blade Symphony Discord Server
notes.content:
[h1]Blade Symphony Discord Server[/h1]


A message from eBunny (a community veteran):

Hello everyone.

I was laying in bed, thinking about what I should do with my life at 5:30am, until out of nowhere, I got a message from god. I grabbed my phone, looked at my messages and there it was: "Make a Blade Symphony Discord server".

Here it is: https://discord.gg/0gaDaXebgoD4CJ3a

For those who are not familiar with Discord, it's a voice and text chatting service made specifically for gamers, similar to TeamSpeak for example, but with some improvements and differences.

You can download the client here[discordapp.com].
(there is also a mobile version, which I heard is pretty good)

[h1]Q&A[/h1]
What?
The server is supposed to be a place for people to chat, get to know each other a little better, make friends, make love, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, help each other, give and receive advice, fully unleash their autism, share wisdom, hang out, discuss things, organize events and tournaments, play together and have fun.

Why?
Read the anecdote above (tl;dr I'm bored and this gives me something to do and focus on).

Where?
The Discord server will be hosted in the Netherlands.

Who can join?
Anyone who is interested.

"The game is dead. Just move on."
Yeah

[h1]Channels[/h1]
These are the current text channels I have in mind (subject to change):
#Blade_Symphony (general)
#Off_topic (♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ goes here too)
#Game_balance
#Help
#Teaching/training 
#Events/Tournaments
#Workshop
#NSFW/lewd (could possibly be combined with off_topic)

I'm not sure about voice channels yet. Feel free to make suggestions.

[h1]Rules/guidelines[/h1]
To actually make this work and to keep a nice atmosphere, I figured some rules or guidelines might be necessary.
This should be common sense, but try to use the channels appropriately. If there is something specific you'd like to ask or talk about, let's say you need some tips for using Phalanx for example, you can ask for help in #Help or look for someone to teach you in #Training.
Related to rule 1 and also pretty obvious. No ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ or NSFW posts outside of #Off_topic or #NSFW.
Be friendly. This should also speak for itself. If things become too toxic or hostile, measures will have to be taken as to maintain the aformentioned decent atmosphere.

Measures may include muting, kicking and/or banning from the server.

If there are any more questions or suggestions, feel free to leave them in this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/225600/discussions/0/492379439683271055/]thread[/url], on the server or message me personally. I've never hosted anything like this before, so help would definitely be appreciated.

notes.title: Patch 3966 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 3966[/h1] ːbsymː

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OSYpa9p.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Summary[/h1]
Hello one and all! It has been a few months since the last patch so first and foremost thank you for your patience. This patch has some bug fixes that we think most of you will be happy to see squashed… The Steam Achievement now works, you can now fully equip your character with workshop items and no longer have to worry about the dreaded ‘Steam Validation Rejected Error’. Stance Masking is hopefully a thing of the past, there are also few other minor fixes in the patch as well.

So the characters’ faces are now officially exposed in the form of unmasked masks, however they won’t be cheap you’ll need 1000 notes to unlock your favorite characters’ face.

Bots (both) have improvements to their abilities, the training bot is worth checking out (If you feel the bot is still too easy, we recommend you set the training mode to 2 vs 1 for extra chaos), also the dev_bot has some nice updated .cfg files.

Balancing…There are some of you who feel the game is in a good spot in terms of balance and of course a good number of you who feel there is a great deal of room for improvement. Generally this balance patch is focused on making less commonly used attacks more useful. There are one or two experimental things in this balance patch but fear not if things do not work out a balance review patch will not be too far around the corner. We would like to take this opportunity to thank some of the community members for working on the balance scripts and testing the scripts, you’ve been a great help!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed male vaulting animations.
[*]Fixed steam validation rejected error (this should resolve not being able to join a server when too many workshop items are assigned to your character).
[*]Fixed the tutorial achievement from not working.
[*]Fixed the ‘stance masking/cancelling’ bug.
[*]Fixed stance changing while performing air cancels and air attacks.
[*]Fixed some security exploits.
[*][Textures] Fixed all Ryoku exponent maps so a bald Ryoku will not have slight colortint on back of head.
[*][Textures] Fixed a spot above Pure’s left ear that was glowing.
[*][Textures] Hidden the seam on Phalanx’s inner arm better for his default and cavalier skins.
[*][Textures] Updated all VGUI mask icons for all characters.
[*]Fixed Ryoku’s Heavy Forward T3 so players no longer get stuck in the air (thanks Niky).
[*]Cleanup of some old console errors to do with textures and models that were fixed for Source Film Maker, but not for the game.
[/list]
[h1]Bots[/h1]
The following applies to bots spawned via the ‘bot’ console command and the ‘bot training menu’.
[list]
[*]Bots now have the ability to meditate while waiting for players to join an arena on LAN and dedicated servers (only for bots spawned via the ‘bot’ console command, not via the bot training menu).
[*]Bots now have the ability to taunt if they win a round.
[*]Bots now have the ability to flourish if they win a match.
[*]Bots will now sometimes attempt to grab at close range or attempt to deflect a grab.
[*]Bots will now sometimes attempt to throw throw-able weapons at long range.
[*]Bots will now try to use their defensive sword techs if their opponent is attacking by default.
[*]Bots will now sometimes use jump and jump attacks by default.
[/list]
The following applies to the ‘dev_bot’ console command and the default bot.cfgs spawned via the ‘exec’ console command.
[list]
[*]Added bot_random_stance convar, bots now switch stances (bot_stance and bot_force_stance must be set to -1).
[*]Improved bot_throw so it is now distance based (the bot will only throw when beyond a certain distance to avoid constant throwing).
[*]Improved all old bot configuration files (now when you exec bot_knight or bot_othercharacter names in console it will kick any current bot_devs).
[*]Improved all old bot configurations in general so they are now set-up to pose a reasonable challenge to new players.
[*]Updated bot_knight.cfg (default uses longsword).
[*]Updated bot_phalanx.cfg (default uses rapier).
[*]Updated bot_ryoku.cfg (default uses scimitar).
[*]Updated bot_pure.cfg (default uses jian).
[*]Added bot_vanguard.cfg (default uses katana).
[/list]

[h1]Characters[/h1]
[list]
[*]All characters now have generic taunt sounds (before only Vanguard had them).
[/list]

[h1]Swords[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the Baseline Alpha Longsword.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
Too many to list here, see link below:
[*][url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2015/11/balance-changes-22112015/]balance-changes-22112015[/url]
[/list]

[h1]Scimitar[/h1]
[list]
[*]“airdamageX” decreased to “1.15” from “1.5”
[*]“forwardAttackDamageX” increased to “0.6” from “0.5”
[*]“sideAttackDamageX” increased to “0.5” from “0.4”
[*]“chargerunx” increased to “1.8” from “1.6”
[*]“blockchipdamage” increased to “2” from “1”
[/list]

[h1]Katana[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased “parryDamageX” decreased to “1.4” from “1.5”
[*]Increased “chargerunx” increased to “0.9” from “0.8”
[/list]

[h1]Longsword[/h1]
[list]
[*]“blockchipdamage” increased to “2” from “1”
[/list]

[h1]Masks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated Phalanx’s Agent A mask visor with a new animation.
[*]Added Judgement unmasked mask (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Judgement unmasked shaved mask (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Ryoku unmasked mask (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Ryoku unmasked shaved mask (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Phalanx unmasked mask (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Pure unmasked mask (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Pure Crow unmasked mask to match her skin 2 blonde hair (price = 1000 notes).
[*]Added Vanguard unmasked mask (price = 1000 notes).
[/list]

[h1]Capes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Blitz Cape for the tournament winner Water (Created by Jester).
[*]Added 2vs2 2015 Cape for the tournament winners Water and WhoArts (Created by Jester).
[*]Added Ryoku Tournament Cape for the tournament winner Skeleton (Designed by fug).
[*]Added Paragon Cape charge texture (Created by Jester).
[*]Added Greater Wing Cape charge texture (Created by Jester).
[*]Added Russian Tournament Cape charge texture (Created by NeshZul).
[/list]

notes.title: Blade Symphony Pick Up Games
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/bladesymphonyPUG

Blade Symphony Pick Up Games
BS PUGS Rules: 

This is a group for organizing pickup games in Blade Symphony. It is all about finding and letting like minded players know you're up for a few duels. 

There are frequent group announcements to start pugs. People usually congregate in the group chatroom and then go to a server once there are sufficient players. 

First join the group chat to see if an announcement has already been made and players are already waiting for others to join before making your own announcement! 
Announcements should be used sensibly to let players know you're up for a game. Please do not spam announcements, or you'll be removed!!! Once you've made an announcement, join the chatroom and wait for 10 - 15 minutes to see if anyone is willing to play. If nobody shows, then I guess no-one is willing to play on that particular occassion, you should not make another announcement, atleast wait a couple of hours before trying again.

Common sense please! 

[h1]I warn you, if you're fine with announcements popping up then by all means join, if that's going to be a thing that bothers you, do not join!!![/h1]

Once you've made an announcement, join the chatroom and wait for 10 - 15 minutes to see if anyone is willing to play. If nobody shows, then I guess no-one is willing to play on that particular occassion, you should not make another announcement, atleast wait a couple of hours before trying again.

Common sense please! 

[h1]I warn you, if you're fine with announcements popping up then by all means join, if that's going to be a thing that bothers you, do not join!!![/h1]

notes.title: New Patch release candidate on Nightly
notes.content:
All,
The new patch's release candidate build is on nightly. There are two nightly servers that are available to play, one on Windows and one on Linux.

[US West] [Nightly] (W) Testing: 192.198.217.30:27015
[US West] [Nightly] (L) Testing: 192.198.217.45:27015

We would like to get this patch out within the next 12-24 hours. Any help testing it's stability or looking for broken features is appreciated. Any balance related changes will be made after this patch.

Here is how to join the nightly test version:

1. On Steam, right click Blade Symphony and go to properties
2. In the Betas tab, in the text box enter the password - [b]winteriscoming[/b] to unlock the beta. 
3. In the box above, switch from None to "Nightly" (not Nightly-Prod)
4. The game will now patch itself on Steam. Wait for it to finish.
5. Join one of the nightly test servers.

The nightly changelog:
http://blade-symphony.com/changelog.txt

There is a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/225600/discussions/0/611696927922018281/]thread[/url] for posting feedback.

You can join our IRC #punyhuman on irc.gamesurge.net, to talk to us and other players about nightly build gameplay changes.

notes.title: Patch (3689)
notes.content:
First of all everybody here at Puny Human would like to wish you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New year!

We recently released a new patch (3689) which added a fifth character to the roster, Vanguard. In this patch we also added new animations and fixed a few outstanding bugs.

This is the final patch of 2014. We would like to thank everyone who has bought and played Blade Symphony this past year, thank you guys and gals! We hope to see you all on the other side!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OyGUlQFYDAY

[h1]Gameplay[/h1][list]
[*]Added new wall climb and side animations[/*]
[*]Added new female jump animation[/*]
[*]Added new character, Vanguard with two alternative skins and masks[/*]
[*]Added bb_hud_team_showhealthbars to disable health bars[/*]
[*]Improved the sprint animations for all characters[/*]
[*]Reduced the block knockback scale to 80%[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Graphics/Mapping[/h1][list]
[*]Added map free_docks[/*]
[*]Cleanup of various outstanding and minor issues on the following maps: cp_docks, free_winter, duel_winter, free_temple and duel_temple[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][list]
[*]Removed stun when hitting wall[/*]
[*]Added missing Whistle sounds to Pure and Vanguards back sheathing animation.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a bug causing servers to not be added to favourites[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the low timer warning to play every second if the duel rounds were set to infinite[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug that made it so you couldn’t jump during moves that allowed full character movement[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug with air cancelling[/*]
[*]Fixed a crash caused by typing anything other than character names after the console command vs_character[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3540 is out, yo.
notes.content:
It’s been a few weeks since we’ve patched, but we’ve hammered out a few small things that we want to get out immediately. Everything we’re working on now are pretty big, and it wouldn’t make sense for us to release it all until it’s done. So until that happens, have a small patch. Enjoy!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1][list][*]Disabled sheathed sprinting while dueling in FFA.[/*][*]Added an option in the menus for turning your in game health bars on and off.[/*][*]Added extra filters into the server browser, you can now hide/show empty and full servers.[/*][*]Tickets no-longer show up when the round is starting.[/*][*]Added a respawn timer to the HUD that counts down from 5.[/*][*]Remade the wall related parkour animations.[/*][*]Added a new action that plays in-between the wall run and wall slide action to transition between the two.[/*][/list][h1]Graphics/Mapping[/h1][list][*]Added new alternate skin and mask for Pure[/*][/list][h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][list][*]Changed the required percentage to vote kick console variable (bb_vote_kick_required_<wbr>percentage) to 60% from 80%.[/*][*]Added console variable for enabling or disabling vote kicking (bb_vote_kick_enable)[/*][*]Added console variable for something else but Ryan couldn’t explain it to me well enough, and I really didn’t want to read the crazy [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/225600/discussions/0/624076027424083776/]forum post about it[/url] (bb_vote_gamemode_enable)[/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*]Fixed duels ending in a draw if a player dies from fall damage.[/*][*]Fixed a number of sound-related console errors.[/*][/list][h1][/h1]

notes.title: Patch 3441 released!
notes.content:
Hey gang!
Thanks to everyone that has helped us track down some issues with the game, including that nasty end of round control point crash. We're still trying to find a fix for the Steam Validation Rejected issue. In the mean time, enjoy this new patch!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Free For All: Players now move faster when they are sheathed.
[*]Control Point: Players can now change who they view when dead.
[*]Control Point: Music now changes depending on whether or not in combat.
[*]Control Point: Spawn times scale based off of players currently playing.
[*]Control Point: Players now spawn instantly during starting period and intermission.
[*]Control Point: Added in-game health bars.
[*]Throwables now require line of sight in order to lock on.
[*]Merged in balance changes from community, [url=https://github.com/punyhumangames/bsbalance/pull/7]see patch notes here[/url].
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Control Point: Fixed a crash that happened if someone was spectating at the end of a round.
[*]Control Point: Fixed a bug causing tickets to never stop flashing if points were all capped.
[*]Control Point: Fixed a bug causing blue HUD points to replay particle effect after pausing.
[*]Fixed a collision problem with the catwalks on free_district
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Users occasionally receive a “Steam Validation Rejected” issue when connecting to a server using Pure workshop items.
[*]Users can work around this by disabling/detaching the Pure workshop items before joining a server from the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3419
notes.content:
First of all I'd like to thank everyone who played Blade Symphony during the free weekend, we love you all, including those who played for free but decided not to purchase*. For those that did purchase Blade Symphony, thank you and I hope to duel with you on the servers. 
During the Weekend we peaked at over 3000 players! This is amazing and broke our previous record of 1336 players!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fJj1V96.gif[/img]

As you may have noticed on Monday we released a small patch to fix some issues that had come to light over the course of the weekend. The change log is below:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Control Point mode: Added some awesomeness for winners during the intermission.[*]Control Point mode: Map never changes if bb_scorelimit is set to 0.[*]Control Point mode: Added text for team change and when waiting on more players to join.[*]Control Point mode: Updated all “capture point” localization text to say “control point”.[*]Control Point mode: Number of tickets flash when your tickets are low or all control points have been captured by the opposing team.
[*]Timer flashes and produces sound when time is low in any mode.[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed HUD not updating properly during intermission.[*]Fixed Control Point bug related to opposing teams capping two points at the same time.[*]Fixed new attachments becoming invisible when a workshop skin has been selected.[*]Fixed new attachments becoming invisible when a workshop skin has been selected.
[*]Fixed new attachments becoming invisible when a workshop skin has been selected.
[*]Fixed wins and losses sometimes showing incorrectly for spectators.
[*]Fixed a crash when specific sounds are stopped.[*]Minor adjustments to ragdoll physics.[/list]

[b]Graphics/Mapping[/b]
[list][*]Material updates for Phalanx, Pure, Ryoku and Knight.[*]Charge textures for all the new character attachments.[/list][i]cp_docks[/i][list][*]Added more spawn points.[*]Moved blue spawn to better match balance timing and point visibility.[*]Made small changes to various materials.[*]Implemented water solution for players using medium or below settings.[/list][i]cp_terrace[/i][list][*]Added more spawn points that prioritize centre points over non-centre points.[/list][i]cp_sequence[/i][list][*]Added more spawn points.
[*]Made small changes to various materials.[*]Implemented water solution for players using medium or below settings.[/list][i]free_temple[/i][list][*]Added more spawn points.[*]Fixed roof bug, allowing players to climb through. (Sorry guys, had to be done.)[/list][i]free_district[/i][*]Added more spawn points.[*]Fixed various nodraw issues.[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list][*]User’s often receive a ‘Steam Validation Rejected’ error.[*]We’re too damn awesome.[/list]


*If you don't own Blade Symphony then why are you reading this announcement? Just curious, so please post in the comments below if this applies to you.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NMC52gQ.jpg[/img]

This new game mode splits players into two teams vying to hold multiple control points. Players will parkour over shipping containers, fighting over sky towers and arenas to hold these control points from the other team.3 new maps have been made specially for this game mode: terrace, a map that plays with vertigo; sequence, where chokepoints become important; and docks, an open map with both indoors and outdoors combat.

[b]Improved Character Customization[/b]

[b][img]http://i.imgur.com/b538Ngc.jpg[/img][/b]
Each character in the game now have separate attachments that you can install. These cosmetic attachments are integrated with Steam Workshop so players can create their own skins, armor, and anything you can imagine.To date, players have created 589 pieces of content, including swords, masks, maps, and graphics modifications. 

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list][*][b]Added capture point game mode.[/b][/list][img]http://i.imgur.com/iWx4qsv.gif[/img][list][*]Players can now further customize their characters by adding or removing Workshop skins and attachments.[/list][img]http://i.imgur.com/kJclGl5.gif[/img][list][*]Added ability to team chat (if you have a pre-existing config, you’ll need to bind it manually via the console).[*]If a player is on blue team, their dash cancel will glow blue instead of red.[*]Added kill notifications into the chat window.[*]Fall damage is now applied if a player is falling fast enough after being hit with a shuriken or thrown.[*]Added Control Point game mode to host menu.[*]Added scoreboard header for server name/time left[*]Added server browser details screen.[*]Added chase cam spectator mode for 2on2 and 2on1.[*]Wall flip now uses keyboard directional input to determine direction/velocity.[*]Players can now climb ledges while just holding forward.[*]Added 'diminishing return' mechanic to wallruns, being unable to continue after 5 wall runs.[*]Added wall sliding mechanic. If a player’s wallrun ends, they will then begin sliding down the wall.[/list][img]http://i.imgur.com/imzvXiE.gif[/img]
[b]ANIMATIONS & ART[/b]
[list][*][b]Updated models and materials for all characters.[/b][*][b]Characters now have individual attachments across 4 slots.[/b][*]Pure now has death animations.[*]Pure's idles now working.[*]Wall jump animations have been updated.[*]Added new mask for Phalanx, “Agent-A.”[*]Made dropped sword entity play sheathed idle animation by default.[*]Added Deploy and Retract sounds to Stacatto Black Sword.[*]Added attachments on customization screen.[*]Corrected an error with Riot Knight skin self-illumination.[*]If a player is glow in FFA or teamplay, the dash cancel proxy will be twice as strong.[*]Shorter male death animations to prevent ragdolls from flipping.[*]Removing all client tracers in interrupt (except tracer parry) to reduce glitchy looking tracers.[/list]
[b]GAME BALANCE[/b]
[list][*]Merged in balance changes from community at https://github.com/punyhumangames/bsbalance/commits/master[*]Changed  block knockback from 1.0 to 1.3 seconds[*]Reduced tracer extension for parries from 0.3 to 0.15 seconds[*]Wall flips are now influenced by gravity[*]Wall runs now inherit velocity from initial run[*]Vault lock duration now set to 0.75[/list][b]See the rest of game balance patch notes here: [/b][url=https://github.com/punyhumangames/bsbalance/wiki/Patch-10-14-14-Balance]https://github.com/punyhumangames/bsbalance/wiki/Patch-10-14-14-Balance[/url]
[b]MAPPING[/b]
[list][*]Added three new Control Point maps: cp_docks, cp_terrace and cp_sequence[*]Added two new FFA maps: free_temple and free_district are both free-for-all versions of their duel counterparts.[*]Added berimbau_capture_point entity, for use in cp_ maps.[*]Added filter_activator_team entity.[*]func_instance is fixed and now works with Blade Symphony.[*]New 2d skybox '360clouds'.[*]Added Enable/Disable functionality to berimbau_spawns, so now you can define different spawn zones (i.e. after a control point switches teams).[*]Can no longer wallrun on sky brushes.[/list]
[b]TRAINING[/b]
[list][*]Added ability to choose training map.[*]Added Bot Training menu, allowing the user to select the desired arena, player vs. player mode,[*]Minor visual and skybox improvements to Tutorial map.[/list]
[b]WORKSHOP[/b]
[list][*]Added subscribed state for workshop visibility.[*]Added workshop jiggle bone warning, removed LOD warning.[*]Put all new workshop constraints or constraint changes behind a workshop ID check, so all existing times will not be validated against any new rules when they are loaded by the client (current ID is 304077814).[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list][*]Fixed custom skins sometimes not being applied when switching between characters.[*]Removed stance speed modifier (it was basically unused, except that it broke move params).[*]Fixed sword not returning to idle anim when attacking from sheathed state.[*]Fixed controlled animation move not reaching 100% on move_x when going backwards.[*]Fixed dash cooldown effect not animating on remote players.[*]Removed cheat flag from kill cmd.[*]Fixed a memory leak issue in the SDK.[*]Added temporary IP ban to vote kick to prevent ban avoidance.[*]Attempted to fix a bug that causes the player to be locked in the air stance.[/list]

notes.title: Blade Symphony update to add control point capture mode
notes.content:
Blade Symphony developer Puny Human plan to slice up their game, only to stitch it back together with a new mode attached. The "Control Point Update" is due out later this week, and will add a team-based capture mode to the duelling sword-'em-up. The update is detailed in a new video.

The new mode works much like Battlefield's ticket system. You'll lose tickets if the opposing team holds more points, or if someone on your team is killed. The first team to shed all their tickets will lose the match.

Three control point maps will be released, with one, Sequence, requiring points be captured sequentially. Players will also be able to create their own maps.

Puny Human says the mode is being treated like a new game unto itself, with different fighting balance than that found in the standard duel mode. Fights are designed to be faster, and all attacks will do 50% more damage.

It sounds like a fun aside to the main meat of duelling. I doubt control point will become the community's main mode, but as a free addition, it should nicely bolster the options of an already great game.

notes.title: Source Filmmaker Update: More Blade Symphony Assets!
notes.content:
[h1]Source Filmmaker Update: More Blade Symphony Assets![/h1]

[quote=SFM Team]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/swDsNmi.jpg[/IMG]

Today we're excited to be able to share a double DLC update with you! First, the [url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/]Blade Symphony[/url] folks have fleshed out their DLC with some beautiful new environments, props and music. There are now snow-covered pagodas, eastern temples, western castles, and even a near-future shopping mall for your virtual location scout to explore. They're also sharing music by their composer [url=http://www.tomstoffel.com/]Tom Stoffel[/url], so you have new options for music under their [url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/about/#monetization]media monetization policy[/url].
[/quote]

You can grab Source Filmmaker [url=http://www.sourcefilmmaker.com/]here[/url] and you can find guides on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sfm]Source Filmmaker Community Hub[/url]

Once you've installed Source Filmmaker be sure to click [i]File[/i] select [i]Downloadable Content[/i] and choose [i]Install Blade Symphony Content Pack[/i]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/lxzfO1m.png[/IMG]

We look forward to seeing your posters and videos!

Also a while back we posted details of a small competition to coincide with this years annual Saxxy Awards, you can see details of the competition [url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/news/]here![/url]

notes.title: Blade Symphony Community Mapping Contest
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/PA6gP0i.png[/IMG]

Welcome to the first ever Blade Symphony Community Mapping Contest sponsored by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/fug4life]fug4life[/url], and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/deefdude/]deef[/url]!

[b]THERE'S CAPES, GUYS.[/b]

[h1]NOTE: EVEN IF YOU HAVEN'T STARTED YOUR MAP YOU STILL HAVE PLENTY OF TIME TO MAKE AND POLISH IT :)[/h1]


[h1]RULES[/h1]
[list]
[*]The tournament will start [b]NOW[/b] and run until [b]September 3rd 2014[/b] (one month long)
[*]Maps submitted can be of any style, and users can submit [i]as many maps as they'd like[/i].
[*]Maps created must [b]clearly show effort was put in to be accepted[/b] (see map criteria). This is just to prevent people from submitting a large amount of garbage maps to up their chances at winning the randomly chosen map prize. (See prizes)
[*]Each map submission can have [b]two users as the creators[/b] (maximum) and the prize pool will be split between them, (each receiving a cape if they win one) so feel free to team up with a friend.
[*]The maps will be judged by a panel of judgements ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/thor]Tetrabor[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/fug4life]fug4life[/url],  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/deefdude/]deef[/url])

[*][u]Contestants must have permission to use custom content not belonging to them.[/u]
[/list]

[h1]PRIZES[/h1]
[b]Best Map[/b]
[list]
[*]The [b]Artist Cape[/b]
[*]Any game on steam priced $50 or under
[*]A copy of the Blade Symphony OST DLC
[/list]
[b]Best Map by a New Mapper[/b]
[list]
[*]The [b]Artist Cape[/b]
[*]Any game on steam priced $50 or under
[*]A copy of the Blade Symphony OST DLC
[/list]
[b]2nd Place by a New Mapper[/b]
[list]
[*]Any game on steam priced $30 or under
[/list]
[b]5 Randomly Chosen Maps[/b]
[list]
[*]Any game on steam priced $10 or under
[/list]

[b]Notice:[/b] No contestant can win more than one prize.

As a bonus, every entered duel map will be hosted on [b]deef's cool server for attractive people[/b] (NA) and [b]fug's teahouse[/b] (EU) for you and others to play on. 

[h1]Community Prize Pool - Should anyone wish to donate[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/bscommunitymap/discussions/0/35219681727668742/]Community Prize Pool[/url]

[h1]MAP CRITERIA[/h1]
The map criteria is pretty easy to keep the contest accessible, but we do have a few key rules:
[list]
[*] Duel maps must have 3 arenas
[*] All arenas must be playable in both 1v1 and 2v2 mode
[*] Map design must be more visually interesting than a cube with the same texture applied to every surface
[/list]


[h1]WHERE TO SUBMIT?[/h1]
Simply publish your map to the workshop, then link to it in the appropriate thread.
[list]
[*]Experienced mappers please submit [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/bscommunitymap/discussions/0/35219681686571859/[/url]here[/url][/b]
[*] New mappers please submit [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/bscommunitymap/discussions/0/35219681686645578/]here[/url][/b]
[/list]
All maps entered to the new mappers category will also be considered for the best overall map prize, since just because you're new doesn't mean you can't be the best.


[h1]RESOURCES[/h1]
[list]
[*][b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=243802847]Tetrabor's Guide to Basic Mapping for Blade Symphony[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=297209867]Tetrabor's vtf and .vmt texture guide[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/3rdparty/]Puny Human Third Party Guides/Resources[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://github.com/punyhumangames/bsmaps]Blade Symphony Map Files[/url][/b]
[*][b]Feel free to add me on steam and I'll do my best to answer whatever questions you may have![/b]
[/list]

[spoiler]Wazoozles! :^)[/spoiler]

notes.title: Dashing Patch 2777
notes.content:
[b][img]http://i.imgur.com/I1KMhQ8.gif[/img][/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2y6iKhK.gif[/img]
(charge dash cancelled into a jump)  

[b]Charge Dash[/b]
We've added a charged version of dash. You can perform this by charging to Tier 2 and holding Roll to dash. During the dash cooldown you take 50% extra damage and can't block stars.[list][*]charge to Tier 2 and roll to execute a charged dash[*]gave dash a 0.4 locktime so players can use it to cancel into attacks[*]players take 50% more damage during the charge dash cooldown (2.5s) and can't autoblock throwing weapons[*]charge dash also triggers roll cooldown so rolls (and therefore wallruns) cannot follow charge dash[/list]



[img]http://i.imgur.com/HvGPh5s.gif[/img]
[b]Parries[/b]
Tracers now extend for 0.35 seconds past the designed period that can be used for parrying.[list][*]0.35s tracer extension[*]parries now maintain momentum of the attack[*]reduced overall knockback for parries[*]increased recovery time from equal tier parries from 0.5 to 0.6[*]increased max allowed tracers from 12 to 20 vertices[/list] 


[b]Phalanx[/b]
[list][*]upped the speed of Phalanx heavy Tier 1 slightly, Tier 2 a bit more, and Tier 3[*]lock times changed from Tier1 from 1.35 to 1.0, Tier 2 1.2 to 0.9, Tier 3 1.9 to 1.6[*]slight animation fixes for Phalanx heavy t3 and re-recorded tracers[/list] 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vyZZ6IU.gif[/img]
[b]Pure[/b]
[list][*]making Pure F2T1 move further and stab further (roughly 1 square more range total) to match Fast 3 Tier 1[*]swapping Pure F3T1 with F3T2, including lock times, knockback, but not damage[*]the new F3T2 now does 20 damage instead of 19[*]sped up Pure heavy left Tier 1 by moving its attack earlier in the animation[*]Pure heavy left damage Tier 1 is now 20, Tier 2 24, Tier 3 28 (used to be 34, 36, 38 respectively)[*]reduced Pure's balanced Tier 1 tracer amount (from ending at 0.8 to 0.7)[/list] 


[img]http://i.imgur.com/ky8qFAB.gif[/img]
[b]Scimitar[/b]
Overhauled scimitar damage output and special ability[list][*]Stance Cancel now replaces side cancelling, you can switch stances and attack to cancel the current attack[*]The rules for Stance cancel are identical to side cancelling (can't cancel the last attack in a string, cancel timing is the same per stance as side cancelling)[*]changed forward multihit scale to 1.0 (now same damage per multihit)[*]increased forward multihit-rate from 0.2 to 0.12 (more multihits, same as Jian)[*]changed damage from 20% global to 50% for forward and 40% for side[/list] 


[b]Rapier[/b]
Changed Rapier's forward attacks to multihit which causes them to combo and work better with balanced stance.[list][*]forward attack multihits rate now same as scimitar side attacks[*]forward attack multihit scales at -60% per attack[*]forward attack damage is now at 50% (and still modified by attack angle)[*]increased heavy damage from 60% to 70%[*]gave Rapier min tier damage, 4 for Tier 1, 6 for Tier 2, 8 for Tier 3[*]slightly increased movespeed for Rapier Guard[/list] 


[b]Katana[/b]
[list][*]+30% faster recovery for side attack parries[*]Katana no longer has its fast attack debuff (80%) and now hit at full damage with fast[/list]

 
[b]Jian[/b]
[list][*]making Jian recovery bonus on hit activate vs block[/list] 


[b]Blocking (Longsword and Scimitar)[/b]
[list][*]added post-attack block cooldown (0.15s)[/list] 


[b]Recovery Attack[/b]
[list][*] sped up recovery attack by 3 frames[/list] 


[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Allow changing loadout during duel warmup[*]Added scrollbars to scoreboard[/list] 


[b]Fixes[/b]

notes.title: Dashing Patch 2777
notes.content:
[b][img]http://i.imgur.com/I1KMhQ8.gif[/img][/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2y6iKhK.gif[/img]
(charge dash cancelled into a jump)  

[b]Charge Dash[/b]
We've added a charged version of dash. You can perform this by charging to Tier 2 and holding Roll to dash. During the dash cooldown you take 50% extra damage and can't block stars.[list][*]charge to Tier 2 and roll to execute a charged dash[*]gave dash a 0.4 locktime so players can use it to cancel into attacks[*]players take 50% more damage during the charge dash cooldown (2.5s) and can't autoblock throwing weapons[*]charge dash also triggers roll cooldown so rolls (and therefore wallruns) cannot follow charge dash[/list]



[img]http://i.imgur.com/HvGPh5s.gif[/img]
[b]Parries[/b]
Tracers now extend for 0.35 seconds past the designed period that can be used for parrying.[list][*]0.35s tracer extension[*]parries now maintain momentum of the attack[*]reduced overall knockback for parries[*]increased recovery time from equal tier parries from 0.5 to 0.6[*]increased max allowed tracers from 12 to 20 vertices[/list] 


[b]Phalanx[/b]
[list][*]upped the speed of Phalanx heavy Tier 1 slightly, Tier 2 a bit more, and Tier 3[*]lock times changed from Tier1 from 1.35 to 1.0, Tier 2 1.2 to 0.9, Tier 3 1.9 to 1.6[*]slight animation fixes for Phalanx heavy t3 and re-recorded tracers[/list] 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vyZZ6IU.gif[/img]

[list][*]making Pure F2T1 move further and stab further (roughly 1 square more range total) to match Fast 3 Tier 1[*]swapping Pure F3T1 with F3T2, including lock times, knockback, but not damage[*]the new F3T2 now does 20 damage instead of 19[*]sped up Pure heavy left Tier 1 by moving its attack earlier in the animation[*]Pure heavy left damage Tier 1 is now 20, Tier 2 24, Tier 3 28 (used to be 34, 36, 38 respectively)[*]reduced Pure's balanced Tier 1 tracer amount (from ending at 0.8 to 0.7)[/list]

[list][*]making Jian recovery bonus on hit activate vs block[/list]

notes.title: BUMP - The World Tournament is now LIVE!!!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6fQuEHK.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/boVGkqy.png[/img]

[h1]Where[/h1]
http://www.twitch.tv/bladesymphonytv

[h1]When[/h1]
Friday June 20th.

[h1]North America[/h1]
9am PST
12pm EST

[h1]Europe[/h1]
6pm CET

[h1]Australia[/h1]
2am AUS

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qFhgLgH.png[/img]

The Blade Symphony World Tournament hosted by Blade Rebellion is closing out with the final tournament to decide a winner between 3 world regions, North America, Europe, and Australia.

Each regional tournament produced 3 finalists who will battle it out in the final tournament happening this weekend. Details below:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nE4sGnG.png[/img]
[h1]SKELETON[/h1]
Having [b]lost only one round the entire tournament[/b], Skeleton is NA's spearhead in this tournament. Skeleton is also the only NA finalist to play more than one character late in the tournament.

Known fighting style: [i]Lightning blocks and relentless punishes[/i]

[h1]MR FONG PAY[/h1]
Fong knocked out the #2 North American seed out of the winners bracket causing a major upset. He has the lowest time played according to Steam of all the region's finalists.

Known fighting style: [i]Hyper aggressive combos and perfect timing[/i]

[h1]HIMURA[/h1]
The [i]Battousai[/i] himself won 8 duels straight from the losers bracket to take third place in the NA finals.

Known fighting style: [i]Almost all fast stance play and rarely blocks[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0cKUEk7.png[/img]
[h1]REIGN[/h1]
His dominating style kept him in the winners bracket the entire tournament. Known as a master of all characters.

Known fighting style: [i]Superb reflexes and timing, impossible to grab[/i]

[h1]ECIOH[/h1]
Known as one of the top Pures and for his extremely defensive play. Pulled out a Judgement against top Ryoku players such as Reign and WhoArts.

Known fighting style: [i]Baits opponents and counters[/i]

[h1]WHOARTS[/h1]
With 3 prior tournament wins, WhoArts was largely expected to take 1st place as Ryoku, however lost after using only Pure until losers bracket.

Known fighting style: [i]Adapts quickly to his opponents styles, good at taking advantage of openings and mistakes[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4tiJnrX.png[/img]
[h1]SERGEANT STONER[/h1]
Came into the tournament with a rough start but stayed in the winners bracket the entire tournament. Also helped organize this tournament.

Known fighting style: [i]"Aggressive counter-attacking"[/i]

[h1]FRIZZY THE PASTAFARIAN[/h1]
Outed by Sergeant Stoner in the winners bracket and returned again for the finals. Took a set off of Sergeant Stoner before his defeat, taking 2nd.

Known fighting style: [i]Aggressive zoning with defensive parries[/i]

[h1]NEURONAUTZ[/h1]
Took two of the less popular character combos straight to 3rd place. Defeated two highly seeded players from the losers bracket.

Known fighting style: [i]Mobile and deceptive play[/i]

[h1]Hype[/h1]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2014/06/blade-symphony-world-tournament/]Post on Facebook[/url]

notes.title: Ladder Reset
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wNrL0LWl.png[/img]

Hi all, a ladder reset has been retroactively applied. It now reflects stats since 2pm PST when the game released.

You can view the global ladder here:
http://blade-symphony.com/ladder

As well as search for yourself using the search function.

Congratulations to mysterious player [ ] for being the world's greatest swordsman! For now...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aiZ9sak.png?1[/img]

League brackets have been slightly altered. Leagues are determined based on your ELO (skill rating point). The following are current league percentiles.

[list]
[*][b]Master[/b] - top 1%
[*][b]Diamond[/b] 2% to 6%
[*][b]Steel[/b] 7% to 25%
[*][b]Iron[/b] 26% to 60%
[*][b]Oak[/b] 61% and below
[/list]

The goal for this change was mainly to make it more challenging to get into Master and Diamond. For example if there are 6000 active players, only 60 get to be Masters league.

Like always, in order to gain or lose ELO you must play others in your own league. We'll be monitoring the ladder and continue adjusting things. It's also possible we'll reset the ladder every so often (for example, by season). Remember, points are not important, learning is important!

notes.title: Official Release: May 7th
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VSALhfq5uJc][img]http://i.imgur.com/fdQTNZp.png[/img][/url]

Direct link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VSALhfq5uJc
We are extremely proud to announce the release of Blade Symphony to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/225600/]Steam [/url]and [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/p/bladesymphony_storefront]Humble Store[/url]. The game will be exiting the Beta / Early Access phase and releasing on[b] May 7th[/b].

A few things will happen on that day:
[list]
	[*][b]Release party![/b] We'll have a twitch.tv stream going on our channel [url=http://twitch.tv/punyhumangames]http://twitch.tv/punyhumangames[/url] so be sure to follow us there. The dev team will be in the servers hanging out and playing with you.
	[*][b]Stats reset. [/b]The [url=http://blade-symphony.com/ladder]official ladder[/url] will be reset and everyone will start from a clean slate.
	[*][b]Beta copies[/b] will be disabled. If you bought the game, then you don't have to worry about this. If you know you have a beta copy, be sure to grab a real copy on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/225600/]Steam Store[/url].
[/list]

[h1]In Less Than One Week[/h1]
This is a personal and humbling moment for myself, and I want to take an aside to reflect on the making of this game.

I started this game project because I was a duelist in Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast, and I wanted to share that same experience I had with others, with people who may not be that interested in Star Wars, but were more interested in the sword-fighting. It began as a hobby which turned into a crusade, and along the way I’ve met incredibly talented developers and artists who helped shape this game every step along the way.

It’s rare that a personal hobby project transforms into a full-fledged game. This is only possible because of the people who believed in us, and supported us. Through Kickstarter, Early Access, press and Youtube, you guys helped spread the word, and joined the beta. You advised us on every minutia and spent hundreds of hours playing and testing and creating awesome new content.

Yes, there is so much room for improvement. When I see the game now, I can’t help but see all the flaws, to quote Phil Phish, “[we] have been staring at it >< this f**king close for years”. Releasing a game is the most terrifying thing I’ve ever had to do. Our team has sacrificed some serious blood, sweat and tears. And, I’d do it all again tomorrow.

On May 7th, we’ll have reached a milestone, and even though it’s called “Release”, this does not stop our patch cycle and we still plan on adding at least one more character, and community features that further expand the game.

The community has been extremely patient and supportive of us, and we owe everything to you guys. I’ve never seen such an awesome, friendly, and helpful community in my entire career, and it’s one that I deeply treasure and am thankful for.

It's not over yet though! You can help spread the word about Blade Symphony on places like [url=http://facebook.com/bladesymphony]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/punyhumangames]Twitter[/url], and [url=http://reddit.com/r/games]Reddit[/url].

See you guys on [b]May 7th[/b]!

[i]~Flux[/i]

notes.title: Patch 2535
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WgyPl2a.gif[/img]
Phalanx's new Air Forward attack

We've got a patch for you waiting on Steam. Lots of game balance and other changes requested by the community made it into this version, so thank you for helping make the game better!

[b]Game Balance[/b]
[list]
	[*]Increased grab damage from 20 to 25 to make up for the buffed wakeup time from last patch
	[*]Reduced shuffle cancel time from 0.3 to 0.22 to prevent "shuffle jump" exploit
	[*]Made jumping velocity take a penalty during hit-stun so jumping isn't as good of a way to get out of bad situations (currently velocity is halved)
	[*]Recovery attack now given extra warmup frames to prevent insta-punishing T3 knockdowns
	[*]Reduced air hitstun animation movement duration from 0.2s to 0.1s so that gravity takes over even sooner, making opponents land earlier when 'juggled'
[/list]
[b]Pure[/b]
[list]
	[*]New Balanced Right T3
	[*]Increased tracers for B3T1
	[*]Swapped B1T2 with B1T3
	[*]Fast Left T1 damage reduced from 17 to 12
	[*]Fast Right T1 damage reduced from 24 to 18, T2 damage from 27 to 24, and T3 damage from 29 to 26
	[*]New voice-over work for several Balanced and Heavy moves
	[*]Re-timed the SFX for her new attacks
	[*]New ledge grab animation
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9bxNENP.gif[/img]

Pure's new Balanced Right Tier 3

[b]Phalanx[/b]
[list]
	[*]Replaced Air 1 with a new attack animation
[/list]
[b]Animation[/b]
[list]
	[*]Updated throwing star animation
	[*]Added sfx to throw star animation
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HTSENDh.gif[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed several bugs and exploits related to string counter (resetting strings via canceling, etc)
	[*]Fixed a prediction error that happens when side canceling into another stance
	[*]Fixed a bug where foil was not able to deal damage for the first 10 seconds of a map
	[*]Fixed potential heap corruption issues in server
	[*]Fixed some potential crashes
	[*]Fixed disconnect confirmation not closing itself when game starts with +map in launch properties
	[*]Fixed highgpu override being ignored when sm3 was not detected
	[*]Rebuilt game engine libraries with fixes to Source Engine
[/list]
[b]Joystick[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added binding translations for controller
[/list]
[b]Workshop[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added workshop item editing
	[*]Fixed some issues when reloading / editing shared resources between multiple items by completely ignoring all mounted VPKs in edit mode
	[*]Added workshop file overview panel
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added a bb_lookat_enabled to enable or disable head turning for screenshots
	[*]Added bb_cam_thirdperson_x_offset and bb_cam_thirdperson_y_offset to offset the camera for taking screenshots
	[*]Made some animations not turn their heads (eg rolls)
	[*]Added text coloring to sword details menu
	[*]Added some workshop localization for client-side mods
	[*]Changed default sit binding to T
	[*]Secret items
[/list]

notes.title: Screenshot Contest
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

We are holding a screenshot contest over the next two weeks to gather some cool new shots of the latest state of the game. Those are going to be used for promotional purposes, e.g. we may use your best screenshots in our website, official announcements, or news posts -- so make sure to max out your graphics settings when taking them!

[b]Prize[/b]
If you submit the best screenshot, you will receive a cape in the next update of the game! Capes can't be obtained through notes in-game, only during special events like this contest. You will get a new, unique cape, that no one else will have.

[b]How to Enter[/b]
To submit your screenshot, [url=http://blade-symphony.com/screenshot-contest/april-2014]click here[/url], click on [i]Upload your screenshot[/i] and choose the screenshot you want to upload. Everyone with a Steam account can sign in and vote for the existing screenshots. Only the screenshot with the most votes will receive the cape, but we will consider using all of your submissions for promotional uses!

[b]Tips[/b]
[list]
[*]Try to be original. Capture something that most people haven't seen.
[*]Make sure the screenshot is at least in 1024x768 resolution or higher. Screenshots should not be low-quality or low resolution.
[*]Because these screenshots will be posted on our website, they need to be appropriate for a wide audience. Please avoid anything that might be considered offensive, obscene, or otherwise inappropriate, including but not limited to the list below:
[list]
[*]Sexual content or references
[*]Anything disparaging to a group of people in the real world
[*]Smoking / drug use
[*]Suicide
[*]Areas that are off-limits or only accessible by means of an exploit
[*]Graphical bugs
[*]Profanity or otherwise questionable chat content onscreen
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Graphics Tips[/b]
If your PC allows it, make sure to max out all settings in the graphics options. Also, check out the ambient occlusion and per pixel motion blur settings, maybe you can use them to make your screenshots look even better! Alternatively, there is a also a depth of field effect that you can turn on in the developer console. To do so, enable access to the console in the [i]Controls[/i] menu, then press F10 to open it. Enter these commands to enable depth of field:
[code]mat_dof_enabled 1
mat_dof_override 1
mat_dof_quality 2
[/code]
Unfortunately, depth of field does currently not play nicely together with the ambient occlusion and per pixel motion blur effects, so you may have to decide for either one of them.



The submission deadline is [b]Saturday, April 19th[/b] (in two weeks), the winner will receive the cape right in the next update that we will release. We are looking forward to see what epic battle scenes you can come up with and which scenic places you can find on our maps!

[h1][b]Please help us by casting your votes![/b][/h1]
[url=http://blade-symphony.com/screenshot-contest/april-2014?]Cast Your Votes Here![/url]

Also, check out the ambient occlusion and per pixel motion blur settings, maybe you can use them to make your screenshots look even better! Alternatively, there is a also a depth of field effect that you can turn on in the developer console. To do so, enable access to the console in the [i]Controls[/i] menu, then press F10 to open it. Enter these commands to enable depth of field:
[code]mat_dof_enabled 1
mat_dof_override 1
mat_dof_quality 2
[/code]
Unfortunately, depth of field does currently not play nicely together with the ambient occlusion and per pixel motion blur effects, so you may have to decide for either one of them.



The submission deadline is [b]Saturday, April 19th[/b] (in two weeks), the winner will receive the cape right in the next update that we will release. We are looking forward to see what epic battle scenes you can come up with and which scenic places you can find on our maps!

[h1][b]Please help us by casting your votes![/b][/h1]
[url=http://blade-symphony.com/screenshot-contest/april-2014?]Cast Your Votes Here![/url]
